sentences.en: Since we got married, he's become a devoted family man.
sentences.zh: 自从结婚以来，他成了一个一心为家的人。

sentences.en: I count myself lucky to have such a devoted wife.
sentences.zh: 能有这么一位一心一意的妻子，我感到很幸运。

sentences.en: I will devote myself to studying for the entrance exams.
sentences.zh: 我会全力以赴准备入学考试。

senses.zh: 把…奉献（给），把…专用（于）,奉献
